question.prompt: Points \(P(a,3)\) and \(Q(-2,b)\) are symmetric about the origin. Find the value of \(a+b\).

solutions.explanation: For points symmetric about the origin, the corresponding x-coordinates and y-coordinates are opposites. Thus \(a=2\) and \(b=-3\), so \(a+b=-1\).
solutions.title: Match opposite coordinates
